checks.name: anchor pinning
checks.assert: frame 0 world point equals the scene anchor (x,z) and baseY + clip height

checks.name: yaw convention
checks.assert: 90deg yaw maps clip +x to world -z, matching sample-at rootAt

checks.name: yaw round-trip
checks.assert: worldDeltaToClip inverts the 37deg trail yaw to 1e-6

checks.name: falloff boundary
checks.assert: weight 1 at grab, 0 at radius, monotone; zero radius moves only the grab frame

checks.name: edit range clamps
checks.assert: windows clamp at frame 0 and clip end; end is exclusive

checks.name: deformation purity
checks.assert: source rootPos/posedJoints bit-identical; full delta at grab; frames outside window untouched; mid-window strictly blended

checks.name: grab picking
checks.assert: nearestTrailFrame returns the exact frame under the pointer

checks.name: effector map validity
checks.assert: every TRAIL_EFFECTOR_JOINTS value is a real cskel27 joint
